variables.name: action_creates_hr_case
variables.description: The candidate tool call creates a new HR case record (e.g. create_new_hr_case).

variables.name: action_short_description_length_invalid
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a short_description / title / brief note argument whose character length is below 30 or above 120.

variables.name: action_short_description_template_mismatch
variables.description: The candidate call creates an HR case with a short_description that does not follow the template 'Service: <...>, Subject: <...>, Detail: <...>'.

variables.name: action_sets_new_case_state_other_than_new
variables.description: The candidate HR case creation call supplies an initial state argument whose value is any state other than 'new'.

variables.name: action_priority_value_not_allowed
variables.description: The candidate call supplies an hr_case priority argument whose value is not one of critical, high, medium, low.

variables.name: action_task_type_value_not_allowed
variables.description: The candidate call supplies an hr_case_task type argument whose value is not one of checklist, survey, hr_service, 'mark when complete', url.

variables.name: action_case_state_value_not_allowed
variables.description: The candidate call supplies an hr_case state argument whose value is not one of new, in_progress, pending, awaiting_approval, resolved, closed, canceled.

variables.name: action_references_hr_service_on_case_create
variables.description: The candidate HR case creation call supplies an hr_service_id argument identifying the service for the case.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state_closed
variables.description: The candidate call updates an existing HR case setting state = closed.

variables.name: action_sets_case_state_resolved
variables.description: The candidate call updates an existing HR case setting state = resolved.

variables.name: action_changes_case_state
variables.description: The candidate call updates an existing HR case with a state argument different from the state last observed for that case.

variables.name: action_assigns_case_or_task_to_user
variables.description: The candidate call sets an assigned_to user on an HR case or HR case task.

variables.name: action_approves_or_rejects_approval
variables.description: The candidate call sets an hr_approval record status to approved or rejected.

variables.name: action_sets_approval_status_value_not_allowed
variables.description: The candidate call supplies an hr_approval status argument whose value is not one of requested, approved, rejected, canceled.

variables.name: action_links_knowledge_to_case
variables.description: The candidate call links a knowledge article to an HR case (e.g. link_knowledge_to_hr_case).

variables.name: action_used_as_value_not_allowed
variables.description: The candidate call supplies a case_knowledge used_as argument whose value is not one of suggested, applied, resolution.

variables.name: action_updates_profile_field_beyond_address_phone
variables.description: The candidate call updates an hr_profile record changing at least one field other than address or phone.

variables.name: context_hr_service_active_verified
variables.description: A prior successful tool observation in this trajectory returned the hr_service identified by the hr_service_id used in the candidate call and showed it as active.

variables.name: context_case_prior_state_resolved
variables.description: The most recent successful observation of the target HR case in this trajectory shows its state is 'resolved'.

variables.name: context_case_prior_state_canceled
variables.description: The most recent successful observation of the target HR case in this trajectory shows its state is 'canceled'.

variables.name: context_case_mandatory_tasks_complete
variables.description: A prior successful observation lists the hr_case_task records of the target case and shows every mandatory task has active = false or state = closed (including the case having no tasks).

variables.name: context_assignee_active_and_group_member
variables.description: A prior successful observation shows the user named as assigned_to in the candidate call is active AND is listed as a current member of the assignment_group specified for that case or task.

variables.name: context_actor_role_manager_or_administrator
variables.description: The request or a prior successful observation establishes that the acting user performing the candidate call has user.role = hr_manager or administrator.

variables.name: context_actor_role_employee
variables.description: The request or a prior successful observation establishes that the acting user performing the candidate call has user.role = employee.

variables.name: context_profile_update_backed_by_case_or_approval
variables.description: A prior successful observation shows an HR case covering the requested profile change, or an hr_approval record with status = approved authorizing it.

variables.name: context_knowledge_article_published
variables.description: A prior successful observation of the knowledge article referenced in the candidate call shows state = published.

rules.title: Keep short descriptions within 30-120 characters
rules.rationale: Free-form text fields have fixed length bounds.
rules.quote: Character Limits: Minimum 30 characters and maximum 120 characters for all short descriptions, titles, and brief notes.
rules.remediation: Supply a short description, title or brief note between 30 and 120 characters.

rules.title: Use the mandated case short_description template
rules.rationale: Case descriptions must identify request type and subject.
rules.quote: Case Short Description Format: Must clearly identify the request type and subject, using the template:
rules.remediation: Format the short description as 'Service: ..., Subject: ..., Detail: ...'.

rules.title: Reference an active hr_service when creating a case
rules.rationale: hr_service_id must reference an active service.
rules.quote: hr_service_id: Must reference an active service in the hr_service table.
rules.remediation: Look up the service first and use an hr_service_id confirmed active.

rules.title: New cases must start in state new
rules.rationale: Default state for all new cases is new.
rules.quote: Default State: All new cases are set to state = new.
rules.remediation: Create the case without overriding state, or with state = new.

rules.title: Use only allowed priority values
rules.remediation: Use one of critical, high, medium, low.

rules.title: Use only allowed case state values
rules.quote: hr_case.state: new, in_progress, pending, awaiting_approval, resolved, closed, canceled
rules.remediation: Use one of the listed hr_case.state values.

rules.title: Use only allowed task types
rules.rationale: Task types are limited to a fixed list.
rules.quote: Task types are limited to: checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.
rules.remediation: Use one of the permitted hr_case_task types.

rules.title: Use only allowed approval status values
rules.remediation: Use one of requested, approved, rejected, canceled.

rules.title: Use only allowed case_knowledge used_as values
Close only from resolved state
rules.rationale: Cases may not jump directly to closed.
rules.quote: Closure Constraint: A case cannot transition directly from any state to closed. It must first reach resolved state.
rules.remediation: Move the case to resolved first, then close it.

rules.title: No transitions out of canceled
rules.quote: canceled is a final state; no further transitions are allowed.
rules.remediation: Do not change the state of a canceled case.

rules.title: Resolve only after mandatory tasks complete
rules.quote: An HR case cannot move to state = resolved until all mandatory tasks (hr_case_task.active = false or hr_case_task.state = closed) are complete.
rules.remediation: Verify and complete all mandatory tasks before setting state = resolved.

rules.title: Assign only to active group members
rules.quote: The assigned_to user must be active and a current member of the specified assignment_group.
rules.remediation: Verify the user is active and a member of the assignment group before assigning.

rules.title: Only managers or administrators approve/reject
rules.rationale: Approval authority is restricted by role.
rules.quote: Actor: Only users with role = manager or role = administrator may approve or reject records.
rules.remediation: Route the approval to a user with manager or administrator role.

rules.title: Link only published knowledge articles
rules.quote: State Constraint: Only articles with knowledge.state = published are visible and linkable.
rules.remediation: Select an article whose state is published before linking.

rules.title: Employee self-updates limited to address and phone
rules.rationale: Other profile updates need a case or approved approval.
rules.quote: Update Restriction: Employees can update only limited fields on their own profile (address, phone). All other updates require an HR case or an approved hr_approval record.
rules.remediation: Limit employee self-service updates to address and phone, or proceed under an HR case or approved hr_approval record.

inventory.quote: If a user request or internal process step violates any protocol listed in this document, you must halt the operation and provide a citation of the specific policy restriction before pausing.
inventory.reason: Meta-behaviour about messaging, enforced implicitly by blocking rules.

inventory.quote: Perform one distinct operation at a time, unless using a pre-approved batch processing utility.
inventory.reason: Cannot judge chaining from a single candidate call.

inventory.quote: Do not provide knowledge, procedures, or employee-specific data that cannot be retrieved directly from the authenticated HR system tables.
inventory.reason: Concerns message content, not a tool-call predicate.

inventory.quote: Do not ask for any information or confirmation from the user.
inventory.reason: Conversational behaviour, not a tool restriction.

inventory.quote: All actions involving sensitive data (PII/PHI) must be logged and audited.
inventory.reason: System-side logging; no exposed pre-action evidence.

inventory.quote: When identifiers such as names or IDs are missing, perform lookups, verify that you are reusing correct values from previous responses, and proceed using the retrieved data.
inventory.reason: Conditional on missing identifiers; specific verification obligations are enforced elsewhere.

inventory.quote: Never assume or fabricate IDs, responses, or outcomes.
inventory.reason: Diligence expectation; partly covered by existence-verification rules.

inventory.quote: Cannot modify core user data (login or role), approval records, or system configuration tables.
inventory.reason: Acting role seldom observable beyond approval actions.

inventory.quote: Limited strictly to their own employee data (hr_profile_id equal to the authenticated user ID).
inventory.reason: Requires authenticated identity binding not reliably observable.

inventory.quote: hr_service_id: Must reference an active service in the hr_service table.
inventory.reason: Pre-action verification of service activity.

inventory.quote: short_description: Must follow free-form text policies (30 to 120 characters).
inventory.reason: Length and template checked on arguments.

inventory.quote: priority: If not provided, the default is moderate.
inventory.reason: Default conflicts with enumeration list; not enforced.

inventory.quote: Default State: All new cases are set to state = new.
inventory.reason: Creation state constrained.

inventory.quote: Upon creation, the system must perform an entitlement check against the subject_person profile and run the associated hr_service.assignment_rule.
inventory.reason: Automated system behaviour, not an agent pre-action predicate.

inventory.quote: The assigned_to user must be active and a current member of the specified assignment_group.

inventory.quote: When an HR case moves to state = in_progress, the system must automatically generate fulfillment tasks (hr_case_task) based on the template defined in the linked hr_service.

inventory.quote: Task types are limited to: checklist, survey, hr service, mark when complete, url.

inventory.quote: An HR case cannot move to state = resolved until all mandatory tasks (hr_case_task.active = false or hr_case_task.state = closed) are complete.

reviewer_format.instructions: Review the proposed HR tool call against the HR Management Assistant Policy. Check: enumerated values (case state/priority, task type, approval status, used_as); short_description length 30-120 and 'Service: ..., Subject: ..., Detail: ...' template; new cases created with state new and an hr_service_id verified active; case state transitions (no direct close without resolved, no transition out of canceled, resolve only after mandatory tasks complete); assignment to a user verified active and a member of the assignment group; approve/reject only by hr_manager or administrator; knowledge links only to published articles; employee profile self-updates limited to address/phone unless backed by an HR case or approved hr_approval. Do not block read-only lookups. Base the decision only on the request, policy defaults, prior successful observations and the candidate arguments; missing evidence is unknown, not permission.

approved.description: True if the candidate call complies with the policy.

extractor_format.instructions: From the user request, policy defaults, prior successful tool observations and the candidate tool call arguments, assign each fact true, false, or null (unknown). action_* facts describe only the candidate call and its arguments; if an argument is absent, the corresponding 'invalid/mismatch' fact is false unless the policy requires otherwise. context_* facts require evidence in the prior trajectory about the SAME actor, case, task, user, service, article or profile named by the candidate; evidence about a different resource or unrelated purpose does not count. Failed or blocked calls establish only reported errors. Never infer from the candidate's own (unavailable) result or from hidden system state. Record for each fact a short evidence string naming the tool call, argument or observation used, or 'no evidence'.
